snippet.title: Chrono Odyssey | State of Unreal | GDC 2024
snippet.description:
A new trailer, first revealed at Epic Games' State of Unreal at GDC 2024.

Explore the world of Setera in Chrono Odyssey. 
Chrono Odyssey is an open world action MMORPG with engaging gameplay mechanics that allow players to manipulate space and time. 
Launching for both PC and console, more details will be revealed in the future.

Link to Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873440/ChronoOdyssey
